checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals event-sequence, description carries event trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals event-sequence; description carries webinar and event trigger phrases.

checks.description: The flow has both a pre-event reminder arc and a post-event follow-up arc.
checks.rule: Body and output present a PRE-event arc and a POST-event arc, each ordered.

checks.description: Pre-event reminders follow the announce 2 to 4 weeks, 1 to 2 weeks, 1 to 2 days, 1 to 2 hours cadence; post emails follow same-day within about 3 hours, day 2 to 3, day 4 to 5.
checks.rule: Body names the announce 2 to 4 weeks, reminder 1 to 2 weeks, reminder 1 to 2 days, final reminder 1 to 2 hours pre cadence and the same-day within about 3 hours, day 2 to 3, day 4 to 5 post cadence.

checks.description: The no-show branch carries one main CTA, watch the replay, not a stacked pitch.
checks.rule: Body states a registrant who did not attend gets one main CTA, watch the replay, and not a stacked pitch.

checks.description: The replay is a limited-time window that expires, taken from the brief, never invented.
checks.rule: Body states the replay scarcity is a limited-time window that expires and that the window comes from the brief.

checks.description: The success metric is attendance then conversion, never a vanity metric.
checks.rule: Body states the success metric is attendance then conversion and not open or click rate alone.

checks.description: Each email carries exactly one clear CTA.
checks.rule: Body states one clear CTA per email.

checks.description: Each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id; the flow never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id and that the flow sequences copy and does not write it.

checks.description: Event date, access details, replay window, offer, price, and promotion trace to the brief; nothing invented.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing an event date, access details, replay window, discount, Skill Path title, or instructor name, and traces them to the brief.

checks.description: The platform open item is surfaced; the package is not-sendable until confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the package design-only and not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals, empowering not deficit-framed, RTL-safe Arabic.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals; any Arabic example is empowering and RTL-safe.
